text: Use `cmd.InheritedFlags()` to inspect the inherited `FlagSet`; it collects parent persistent flags that are not locally shadowed (`command.go:1695-1719`). Tests can assert `cmd.HasInheritedFlags()` for any inherited flags or `cmd.HasAvailableInheritedFlags()` for inherited flags that are not hidden or deprecated (`command.go:1766-1770,1788-1792`).
